主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. released its financial results for the fourth quarter of 2011 and the full year ended December 31, 2011. The report was issued on February 1, 2012, and included details about the company's performance during these periods. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The information provided in the report is not considered "filed" under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless explicitly stated. The report was signed by Richard L. Bergmark, the Chief Financial Officer of Core Laboratories N.V.
